entries.title: The Stopera, the NAP under it and the Violist
entries.reason: coordinator: re-source Kunstgebit, Schippers wedding room, before drafting
entries.hook: Town hall and opera fought as "Stop de opera"; inside, sea level as a bolt and an anonymous violinist in the floor.

entries.title: Nieuwmarkt metro station, the riot remembered underground
entries.hook: The station dug where the houses fell shows the 1975 riots in its art, and hides a 3,000-person Cold War shelter.

entries.title: Living by Numbers, the HIV/AIDS monument on the IJ
entries.reason: "first in Europe" is the makers' claim
entries.hook: Beads that counted toward 2030, the target for no new infections; called Europe's first HIV/AIDS monument.

entries.title: Megadlé Jethomim and the Monument Joods Verzet
entries.reason: one "memorials around the Stopera" pin possible
entries.hook: Paving traces an orphanage whose hundred boys and three carers went to Sobibor; beside it, Jews who fought back.

entries.title: De Dokwerker and the February Strike
entries.reason: on the Jewish Cultural Quarter square (statue itself not A-list)
entries.hook: Andriessen's docker for the 1941 strike; turned toward the synagogue in 1970 for the metro.

entries.title: The smoking skipper the city said no to
entries.hook: A twenty-metre skipper painted after the city refused permission; the canal shows through his coat.

entries.title: Where the Maupoleum stood: the "Colosseum", the green glass box and the tunnel
entries.hook: The ugliest building's successors got nicknames before they were finished; under the square, a motorway tunnel.

entries.title: Arcam's folded pavilion and the Museumhaven
entries.hook: An aluminium sculpture of an architecture centre, and twenty working boats that are lived in, not a museum.

entries.title: Nieuwmarkt square: the plane-tree fight, the paving-slab bird and the scaffold
entries.reason: the Waag is A-list: pitched on the square
entries.hook: Residents planted and fought over plane trees, a carver made a bird from a broken slab, the guillotine fell once here.

entries.title: The plaque for the Nieuwmarkt children, De Flesseman
entries.hook: Four neighbourhood boys shot in 1944-45, one two minutes after curfew; former residents put up the plaque in 1995.

entries.title: Vlooienburg under the Stopera: the plaque that took thirty years, and Spinoza
entries.reason: one Stopera pin possible with CC-04 / AC-23
entries.hook: The Jewish island under the city hall got a plaque for its murdered residents only in 2022; Spinoza stands outside.

entries.title: Lastage: the 1971 stone of nailed-up windows and the bridges for the neighbourhood's fighters
entries.hook: A gable stone shows the boarded-up Lastage of 1971; two bridges carry the names of the men who stopped the motorway.

entries.title: Leprozenpoort and the Grenspaal: the lepers' gate that moved, and a turtle carrying city debris
entries.hook: A lepers' gate with clapper-holding figures, rebuilt down the street; beside it a turtle carries scraps of demolished Amsterdam.

entries.title: Coentje Gans Plantsoen, a hidden garden for child victims of war
entries.hook: A gate that looks shut opens on a garden named for a boy of one murdered in Sobibor.

entries.title: Kalkmarkt 8, the seamen's doctor's pun stones
entries.hook: A port doctor named Voorsluis put a sluice on his house: "Exonerat et arcet".

entries.title: Valkenburgerstraat, shot after the surrender (5 May 1945)
entries.hook: After the capitulation German police stormed a building; four men who came to free the trapped were killed.

entries.title: The Tak family's six stones, Sint Antoniesbreestraat 98
entries.hook: Six stumbling stones for one household of the old Jewish quarter.

entries.title: A.S. Onderwijzerhof, a hofje from the 1980s
entries.hook: A hofje of the 1980s in the Nieuwmarkt quarter.

entries.title: OBA Oosterdok, the free view from the library roof
entries.hook: One of the few free high views of the old city, from the library that replaced the post tower.

entries.title: Speeltuin De Waag, a playground since 1932
entries.hook: A neighbourhood playground association on the same spot since 1932, still collecting old players' memories.

entries.title: The Marionettentheater in the old smithy
entries.reason: Okay; second source needed for the smithy meetings
entries.hook: A seventy-seat puppet theatre in the smithy where the Aktiegroep Nieuwmarkt met; a squatters' map of 200 addresses inside.

entries.title: Fort van Sjakoo, the bookshop from the squatters' years
entries.hook: An anarchist bookshop of 1977, born from the neighbourhood's resistance of the seventies.

entries.title: Huis Serne, a century of theatre costumes
entries.hook: Amateur actors ran a costume hire here from 1883; a ceiling painting ended a painter.

entries.title: Ruijtergaard, an orchard in crates
entries.hook: Pipes under the quay ruled out trees, so residents built a food forest in raised beds of city elm wood.

entries.title: Buurtpark 's-Gravenhekje
entries.hook: A residents' park on the old ramp to the rubbish barges, facing the Montelbaanstoren.
